title: Grothendieck Brown localization retract
statement: Under the hypotheses of `CategoryTheory.grothendieckDerived_cohomological_isRepresentable`, the underlying set-valued functor is a natural retract of the universe-lifted Yoneda functor of some object of the derived category: there exist E : DerivedCategory A and a `Retract` from `(H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat) ⋙ uliftFunctor` to `uliftYoneda E`.

source.place: injectives-lemma-brown, first two paragraphs through the direct-summand conclusion

proof.text: Obtain a localization L left adjoint to R with invertible counit and a representing object E for the pullback of the lifted underlying functor F, using [lem-g2-grothendieck-derived-localization-brown-data].

The left triangle identity makes L(unit_E) the inverse of the counit at L(E). Consequently F composed with L.op inverts unit_E.op. The representing natural isomorphism makes Hom(unit_E,E) bijective; its inverse applied to the identity gives s with unit_E followed by s equal to identity. This is the Lean private helper localization_retract.

Apply lifted Yoneda to the split pair and precompose with R.op. Whiskering the representing isomorphism and the opposite counit identifies the first endpoint with F. Full faithfulness of R identifies the second endpoint with lifted Yoneda of L(E), naturally by the Hom equivalence. Compose these retracts to obtain the required witness. All these transports and naturality equalities are proved in Lean.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph for localization data; the unit splitting is shortened using representability and inversion of L(unit), and the natural transports are explicit Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem grothendieckDerived_brown_retract
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)]
    (H : (DerivedCategory A)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{vH}) [H.IsHomological]
    (hH : ∀ I : Type (max w vA vH), PreservesLimitsOfShape (Discrete I) H) :
    ∃ E : DerivedCategory A,
      Nonempty (Retract (H ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat ⋙ uliftFunctor.{w})
        (uliftYoneda.{vH}.obj E))
